name: Glabrezu
resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The glabrezu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The glabrezu makes four attacks: two with its pincers and two with its fists. Alternatively, it makes two attacks with its pincers and casts one spell.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). The glabrezu has two pincers, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Fist
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
